title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer - First Responder

description.narrative: 'First Responder' is an initiative aimed at raising awareness and knowledge in first aid and emergency response. The project focuses on training individuals to become first responders capable of handling emergencies efficiently and effectively.

Promote health awareness: spread knowledge of the importance of first aid and emergency response methods in the community. Develop skills: provide comprehensive training enabling individuals to deliver immediate and effective assistance in emergencies. Empower the community: equip individuals with the knowledge and skills needed to save lives and improve public safety.
